_note: The list of 2026-11-22 (docs/improvements16.txt: the caves' treasures), its plan's phases 10 to 17 (docs/improvements16_plan.md). 945 items writes them on every map of the game ('maps'): each item copied from its 'like' with its own kind, numbers, buff [kind, amount, seconds], picture ('icon': icons16/icon_<icon>.png), tiers ([]: every tier) and weight in the containers' draws (0: only where it is put or made); 'cave': drawn only in a cave (a cave's gear, rings, tomes and scrolls come from these alone); 'repairs': a repair item's armour weight ('light', 'medium': it mends only that). Recipes: [station, [[label, [any of], count], ...]] (station '' the anvil, 'Alchemist', 'Librarian', 'Oven'). 'regions': a region's biomes (its caves' towers') and the items found only in its caves. 'nodes': veins and growths laid in a cave's rooms, their harvest pile's item and count.

items.name: Deepiron Ore
items.looks: A lump of dark ore hacked from a cave's wall: deepiron, found nowhere above ground. Three make an ingot at an anvil.

items.name: Deepiron Ingot
items.looks: A bar of smelted deepiron, darker and harder than any smith's iron.

items.name: Glowcap
items.looks: A pale mushroom that glows faintly in the dark. Brewed, it lets the eyes see without a torch.

items.name: Grave-moss
items.looks: A grey moss that grows on old bones underground. Brewed, it guards against poison and slowly mends.

items.name: Cave Pearl
items.looks: A pearl grown in a cave pool's still water. Merchants pay well for it.

items.name: Bat-wing Leather
items.looks: Thin tough leather from a cave bat's wing. Two make a patch for light armour at an anvil.

items.name: Crawler Chitin
items.looks: A plate of a cave crawler's shell, cut to fit: it mends medium armour.

items.name: Bat-wing Patch
items.looks: Bat-wing leather stitched into a patch: it mends light armour.

items.name: Blind-fish Oil
items.looks: Oil pressed from the blind fish of cave pools: rubbed on a torch or the ankh, it burns twice as long for twenty minutes.

items.name: Giant's Femur
items.looks: The thigh bone of something far larger than a man, older than any kingdom. A smith could make a named weapon of it.

items.name: Wyrm Vertebra
items.looks: A vertebra of a wyrm, hard as stone. A smith could make a named weapon of it.

items.name: Amber with an Insect
items.looks: A drop of amber with an insect held in it since the world was young: a reagent, and a curiosity collectors seek.

items.name: Petrified Wood
items.looks: A branch turned to stone: a reagent, and a curiosity collectors seek.

items.name: Frost Quartz
items.looks: A cold blue quartz from the caves of the frozen lands. Worked with leather at an anvil, it lines gear against the cold.

items.name: Sun-glass
items.looks: A glass the desert's heat made underground. Woven with leather at an anvil, it keeps gear cool.

items.name: Geode Shard (Blue)
items.looks: A blue crystal from a geode of the cold lands' caves.

items.name: Geode Shard (White)
items.looks: A white crystal from a geode of the mountains' caves.

items.name: Geode Shard (Red)
items.looks: A red crystal from a geode of the volcanic lands' caves.

items.name: Geode Shard (Yellow)
items.looks: A yellow crystal from a geode of the canyons' and savannahs' caves.

items.name: Geode Shard (Green)
items.looks: A green crystal from a geode of the forests' and wetlands' caves.

items.name: Geode Shard (Violet)
items.looks: A violet crystal from a geode of the open lands' and coasts' caves.

items.name: Darksight Draught
items.looks: A glowcap brew: for five minutes your eyes see 18 m into the dark without a torch.

items.name: Grave-moss Antivenom
items.looks: A bitter grave-moss tincture: for five minutes poison hurts you far less.

items.name: Slow Mending Draught
items.looks: Grave-moss, glowcap and old amber steeped together: your wounds close slowly for three minutes.

items.name: Frost-quartz Lining
items.looks: Frost quartz worked into leather and sewn into your gear: for half an hour the cold comes on far more slowly.

items.name: Sun-glass Weave
items.looks: Sun-glass threads woven into your gear: for half an hour the heat comes on far more slowly.

phase11._note: Geodes cut at the librarian's table: an ink (one shard) stands in for any scroll recipe's reagent (945 adds the inks to every scroll recipe's part that is not its essence); a socket stone (two shards) set in a weapon or a set of armour (one socket each) gives its colour's bonus while that weapon is in her hands or that armour on her (sockets: stone -> [stat, amount]; RDCave16c.cpp).

phase12._note: The caves' weapons: each copied band by band (its plain, Fine, Masterwork, Exalted, Celestial and Divine items, their tiers) from a weapon of the table ('like'), every hero's fit kept; damage and durability times the figures given; 'mesh' another mesh on the like's grip by the two meshes' frames (the pick: its head the blade's end, the grip 22 % up the handle); 'material' its look on every slot; 'mended_by' the only things that mend it; 'breaks_rubble' the rubble's breaker; 'lightless' its shot leaves her hidden and draws no trail; 'lost' a lost adventurer's blade (weight 0: laid by a skeleton deep in a cave, one a cave). Rubble: the meshes across a set's side tunnel.

weapons.name: Miner's Pick
weapons.looks: An old miner's pick, heavy in both hands: a weapon at need, and one blow of it breaks the rubble that closes a cave's side tunnels.

weapons.name: Shard Blade
weapons.looks: A blade of cave crystal: it cuts deep and chips fast. No smith's repair holds on it: only a geode shard, used, mends it.

weapons.name: Jawbone Club
weapons.looks: The jaw of some great cave beast, teeth and all: dark, cheap and brittle.

weapons.name: Rib Dagger
weapons.looks: A rib ground to a point: dark, cheap and brittle.

weapons.name: Lightless Bow
weapons.looks: A bow of blackened wood whose arrows leave no trail: shot from hiding, it does not give you away, and the one it strikes does not turn to find you.

weapons.name: Maren's Falchion
weapons.looks: A named blade found by a skeleton deep in a cave. A note beside it: Maren Holt of the Brokenspire watch went down after her brother and did not come back up.

weapons.name: Corvin's Gladius
weapons.looks: A named blade found by a skeleton deep in a cave. A note beside it: Corvin the map-maker: the map in his pack ends three rooms short of here.

weapons.name: The Sandwalker's Khopesh
weapons.looks: A named blade found by a skeleton deep in a cave. A note beside it: A trader from the canyons, by the red sand still in its scabbard.

weapons.name: Old Hessa's Notched Blade
weapons.looks: A named blade found by a skeleton deep in a cave. A note beside it: Hessa came down alone; every notch on the edge is a fight she won.

weapons.name: Lysander's Rapier
weapons.looks: A named blade found by a skeleton deep in a cave. A note beside it: A duellist's blade; a letter to someone named Ilse is folded beside it, never sent.

weapons.name: The Warden's Runed Blade
weapons.looks: A named blade found by a skeleton deep in a cave. A note beside it: A warden of the broken tower: the runes on the blade still glow faintly in the dark.

phase13._note: The caves' armour: copies of the fitted sets in new materials, band by band (where a map has the bands), every hero's fit kept: 'amount' added to the share of a blow it takes (the deepiron sets one band's 0.04 better), 'durability' times; 'perk' what it does while worn (notice: monsters notice her from that share of their distance; darksight: metres; poison: a poison's hurt that share less; breath: her breath that many times as long); 'recipe' at its station, by band ('ingots': the deepiron ingots of the plain band, one more a band). The drowned knight's four pieces lie one in each cave (by its key) in its flooded side tunnel's dry end, and make the set at the anvil. 'flood': the flooded side tunnels' share and the water's material, her breath, the water's bite and her speed under it.

items.name: Drowned Knight's Helm
items.looks: The drowned knight's helm, crusted with barnacles, found in a flooded cave's dry end. The helm, cuirass, gauntlets and greaves together make his armour at an anvil.

items.name: Drowned Knight's Cuirass
items.looks: The drowned knight's cuirass, crusted with barnacles, found in a flooded cave's dry end. The helm, cuirass, gauntlets and greaves together make his armour at an anvil.

items.name: Drowned Knight's Gauntlets
items.looks: The drowned knight's gauntlets, crusted with barnacles, found in a flooded cave's dry end. The helm, cuirass, gauntlets and greaves together make his armour at an anvil.

items.name: Drowned Knight's Greaves
items.looks: The drowned knight's greaves, crusted with barnacles, found in a flooded cave's dry end. The helm, cuirass, gauntlets and greaves together make his armour at an anvil.

armour.name: Spelunker's Armour
armour.looks: Soft, dark leathers a cave-walker wears: monsters hear her steps from four fifths as far, and her eyes see a little into the dark.

armour.name: Chitin Plate
armour.looks: Plates of a giant crawler's shell over padding: heavy, and a poison hurts its wearer half as much.

armour.name: Drowned Knight's Armour
armour.looks: The drowned knight's armour, put together again: whoever wears it holds her breath three times as long under water.

armour.name: Deepiron Mail
armour.looks: Light mail of deepiron: a band better than any smith's of its kind.

armour.name: Deepiron Scale
armour.looks: Scale armour of deepiron: a band better than any smith's of its kind.

armour.name: Deepiron Plate
armour.looks: Plate of deepiron: a band better than any smith's of its kind.

phase14._note: The charm slot (a ring of kind CHARM, one at a time beside her rings), the Ring of the Echo and the miner's lucky stone (rings of kinds of their own, worn by every hero). 'amount': the Echo's metres, the lucky stone's share more. 'charm': its good and, for a cursed relic, its cost (a stat and its share: damage, guard, speed, gold, notice, maxhp, bleed (a share of her hit points a second), light (metres)) and the temple's price to lift it (times 1 + 0.25 a game tier past the first). 'like': '' takes the first ring of the map.

items.name: Ring of the Echo
items.looks: A ring set with a cave pearl that hums with the cave's echoes: monsters within 60 m show on your maps as dim pings.

items.name: Miner's Lucky Stone
items.looks: An old miner's lucky stone on a cord: veins and growths give half as much again.

items.name: Glow-worm Amulet
items.looks: A vial of glow-worms on a chain: a faint light round you without a torch, both hands free.

items.name: Bleeding Idol
items.looks: A small idol that weeps blood: your blows strike harder while you bleed slowly.

items.name: Gilded Skull
items.looks: A skull gilded long ago: more gold comes to you, but monsters notice you from farther off.

items.name: Black Candle
items.looks: A candle of black wax that never burns down: it sharpens your blows, but it draws on your life.

items.name: Thorned Crown
items.looks: A crown of iron thorns: blows on you are lighter, but its weight slows you.

phase15._note: Rewards that last: a fossil set per region (found in its caves only; a full set, amber standing in for one, traded at a temple for hit points or mana for good, or an Angel Token); ancient tablets teaching a recipe (recipe items: the recipe they teach is locked until read) or a spell ('spell_tablets': copies of that many of the highest tomes, renamed); the cave painting (a decal cut from its icon by blender_numpy/cave_painting_decal.py, in a share of the sets; studied, it marks the region's caves and their hidden places on the wilds' map); an Angel Token from a cave's last boss (C++).
